parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
> This parameter is applicable only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call the [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) operation to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC) in seconds.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: OrderWay
parameters.description:
The sort order of the list. Valid values:

- **asc**: ascending order.

- **desc**: descending order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number when using paging. Sets the current page number. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC) in seconds.
